metadata.title: Endpoint Health and Compliance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for continuously evaluating endpoint health and compliance and emitting posture signals used in access and policy decisions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint telemetry, compliance assessment, configuration state assessment, and monitoring services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern defining continuous evaluation of endpoint health and compliance as posture signals, without performing enforcement actions.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Health and compliance evaluation applies only to endpoints that satisfy Endpoint Core trust requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint health and compliance align with NIST guidance on continuous monitoring and log management.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint posture is a core input signal in Zero Trust access decisions.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Health and Compliance defines how endpoint state is continuously evaluated and signaled to other systems. This pattern intentionally does not enforce configuration, remediate issues, block access, or initiate response. It exists solely to produce authoritative posture signals.

components.title: Endpoint Health Assessment
components.description: Continuously evaluates endpoint operational health, including security agent status and core service integrity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairing defenses to evade detection or compliance checks.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous health monitoring detects loss of protective capability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: The endpoint environment is monitored to detect changes in security-relevant state.

components.title: Endpoint Compliance Evaluation
components.description: Assesses endpoint configuration state against defined compliance expectations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of endpoints that silently drift out of compliance to maintain access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Configuration state assessment detects compliance drift.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint configuration state is monitored for unauthorized or unintended changes.

components.title: Posture Signal Emission
components.description: Emits normalized posture signals to identity, network, and application control planes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Concealment of non-compliant state to evade enforcement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Verified telemetry and signal integrity prevent spoofed posture assertions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security state is continuously assessed and reported.
Posture and compliance signals are traceable and auditable.
